description: Combine 2-20 PDF files into one PDF, in the order given. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

files.description: The files, each with file_url or file_base64

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

name: merge_pdf

expires_in_minutes.description: The link stops working after this time (or 3 minutes after the first download)

title: Merge PDF
